keyword: concrete pump model number is not m3/h

title.en: The Numeral in a Pinjin Model Name Is Not the Output
title.zh: 品锦型号名称里的数字不是输送量

description.en: On Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s Xingtai sheets, the number in the name is not m³/h. Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h.
description.zh: 在河北品锦机械的邢台参数页上，名称里的数字不是 m³/h。电动30印 12–15 m³/h。柴油30印 15 m³/h。电动10系列印 21 m³/h。

h1.en: Read the Output Cell, Not the Numeral in the Name
h1.zh: 读输送量格子，不要读名称里的数字

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not define the numeral in a model name as theoretical output. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Electric 60 prints 40 m³/h while Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 35 m³/h. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h while HBT80-16, which shares the string HBT80-1816-110, prints 50 m³/h. Put the output cell in the inquiry, and keep the name only as the path.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）没有把型号名称里的数字定义成理论输送量。柴油30印 15 m³/h。电动60印 40 m³/h，电动低压60印 35 m³/h。电动80印 60 m³/h，而与之共享字符串 HBT80-1816-110 的 HBT80-16 印 50 m³/h。询盘里写输送量格子，名称只作为路径。

heading.en: Three names that under-shoot or over-shoot

body.en: Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h, above the “10” in the name. Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h, below the “120”. Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h. Quote the range or the single figure exactly as the page prints it.
body.zh: 电动10系列印 21 m³/h，高于名称里的“10”。柴油120印 100 m³/h，低于名称里的“120”。电动20印 8–10 m³/h。按页面印出的区间或单值原文报价。

heading.en: Output is not a promised site total
heading.zh: 输送量不是工地承诺总量

body.en: The sheets call many of these lines theoretical output or output capacity. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print an on-site guaranteed m³/h beside them. Your inquiry can state the output you need; Xingtai then matches a printed cell. It does not turn the cell into a new guarantee on this page.
body.zh: 这些表把许多行称为理论输送量或输出能力。河北品锦机械没有在旁边印工地保证的 m³/h。询盘可以写你需要的输送量；邢台再对照已印格子。本篇不会把格子改写成新的保证值。

heading.en: How to write the output in the inquiry

body.en: Write the figure from the page and the figure you need as two separate numbers. Example: “Electric 30 page prints 12–15 m³/h; we need to discuss X.” Do not replace 12–15 with 30 because the name says 30. Contact [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 把页面上的数字和你需要的数字分成两个数来写。例如：“电动30页印 12–15 m³/h；我们需要讨论的是……”不要因为名称是 30 就把 12–15 改成 30。联系 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

answer.en: The sheet prints 60 m³/h, 110 kW and 900 m / 300 m.
It prints 30 m³/h, 6105 / 99 kW and 150 m / 450 m.

question.en: Is a range such as 8–10 one number?

answer.en: No. Electric 15 and Electric 20 print 8–10 m³/h. Keep the range.
answer.zh: 不是。电动15和电动20印的是 8–10 m³/h。保留区间。

question.en: Who confirms whether a needed output fits?
question.zh: 谁确认需要的输送量是否对得上？

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, after you send both numbers to the contact page.
answer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台），在你把两个数字发到询盘页之后。
